notes: Excerpt of the 2026 Annual Budget (20 scanned pages). Unlike part 1, the pages here do not carry 'Page x of 424' numbers: the LBP Form 2 pages are numbered within their own fund sections, 'Page 5-6 of 15 Pages' (Office of the Market and Slaughterhouse, p-01..p-02) and 'Page 7-10, 14-16, 18 of 47 Pages' (hospital fund: Lapu-Lapu City Hospital p-03..p-06, Sta. Rosa Community Hospital p-07..p-09, Non-Office - Hospital - 5% p-10). Printed pages 11-13 and 17 of 47 are not in this scan. The FDPP Form 1b summary pages (p-11..p-20) carry no page numbers.
p-06, p-15 and p-18 are signature-only pages (no figures).

Columns: 2024 Past Year Actual, 2025 First Semester Actual, 2025 Second Semester Estimates, 2025 Total, 2026 Budget Year Proposed. Amounts in full pesos. On the FDPP Form 1b summary pages the column-3 header is printed blank; it holds the 2024 past-year actuals and is mapped to pastYear.

Account codes are transcribed as printed; codes printed with a leading dash carry the fund/office prefix of the first code in the block (8811 Market, 4421-1 Lapu-Lapu City Hospital, 4421-2 Sta. Rosa Community Hospital, 9998 Non-Office).

Tables summary-general-fund, summary-hospitals and summary-market are the FDPP Form 1b 'Annual Budget Report, Summary' (Programmed Appropriation and Obligation by Object of Expenditure) for the General Fund, the Hospitals and the Market. They are fund-level summaries, not offices, and are excluded from summary.offices. The General Fund summary has a '3.0 Financial Expenses' block (Loan Payable, section 'financialExpenses'; 2026 proposed blank) and its unlabeled bottom row (2026 proposed 4,255,383,282.00) is kept as the table total.

Office of the Market and Slaughterhouse, Year End Bonus (-5-01-02-140): printed 2025 First Semester blank + Second Semester 221,364.00, but the printed 2025 Total is 597,072.00 (diff 375,708.00). The PS SUB-TOTAL (8,443,760.74) and Grand Total (23,231,694.30) Second Semester figures on the office form carry the same 375,708.00 gap, while the FDPP Form 1b Market summary prints Year End Bonus Second Semester as 597,072.00 (PS Sub-Total 8,819,468.74, Total Expenditures 23,607,402.30). Transcribed as printed on each page.

FDPP Form 1b Market summary: past-year Other Personal Benefits (320,000.00 on the office form) is printed blank and Monetization of Leave Credits is printed 466,982.35 (146,982.35 on the office form); the PS Sub-Total is the same. It also splits Printing and Publication Expenses (20,000.00) out of Other MOOE (584,000.00 / 684,000.00) and prints Medical Allowance without an account code. Transcribed as printed.

Non-Office - Hospital - 5% (LDRRMF for the hospitals): the 30% Quick Respond Fund is a separate printed block (section 'qrf', 1,200,000.00 proposed) and is reported in summary.offices as 'qrf'; therefore the office's PS+MOOE+CO (2,800,000.00) is less than its printed TOTAL 4,000,000.00 by exactly the QRF amount. Its 2025 Capital Outlay item (Machinery & Equipment - Medical Equipment, 2,800,000.00) has no account code printed.
Capital Outlay blocks of the Market office, Sta. Rosa Community Hospital and Non-Office - Hospital - 5% have no 2026 Budget Year Proposed amounts printed (blank); recorded as null.
